subtopics.title: From Magma to Lava — and Why Some Eruptions Explode

questions.question: The correct distinction between magma and lava is:
options: Magma is molten rock below the surface; lava is the identical material once it emerges
Magma is cool rock; lava is hot rock
Lava is underground; magma is on the surface

questions.question: At convergent boundaries, magma is generated because:
options: The plates rub together and friction melts them completely
Water sweated out of the descending slab lowers the melting point of the mantle wedge above it
Sea water pours down the trench and boils

questions.question: Tristan da Cunha, whose community was evacuated during its 1961 eruption, is used as an example of:
options: A HOT-SPOT volcano — a plume rising under the middle of a plate

questions.question: High-silica magma erupts EXPLOSIVELY because it is:
options: Stiff enough to seal its own vent like a cork, so trapped gas pressure climbs until the seal fails

subtopics.title: The Structure of a Volcano and the Main Types

questions.question: From the bottom upward, the anatomy of a volcano runs:
options: Magma chamber, vent, crater, with the cone stacked around the vent and parasitic cones on the flanks

questions.question: A caldera such as the one filled by Crater Lake in Oregon forms when:
options: Lava carves out a wide basin
A colossal eruption drains the magma chamber and the unsupported summit collapses into the void

questions.question: Kilauea in Hawaii illustrates the SHIELD volcano because it:
options: Is a small steep pile of loose cinders
Pours out far-travelling runny basalt, building an immensely wide cone with slopes of only a few degrees
Grew from lava too stiff to flow

questions.question: Composite volcanoes such as Pinatubo are built from:
options: Hundreds of alternating layers — explosive ash beds sealed beneath calmer lava flows — giving a tall, steep, concave cone

questions.question: The Drakensberg and the Lesotho highland are a lava PLATEAU because they consist of:
options: Sheet upon sheet of fissure-fed basalt, stacked as Gondwana tore apart about 180 million years ago — hence the level ramparts and steps

questions.question: A sill and a dyke differ in that:
options: A sill cuts across the layers; a dyke lies between them
A sill spreads BETWEEN existing rock layers, parallel to the bedding; a dyke cuts ACROSS them, standing steep or vertical
Both always reach the surface as lava
A dyke is always wider than a sill

questions.question: Karoo koppies are flat-topped because:
options: A resistant dolerite sill armours the top of each hill while the softer shale around it washes away — with the Valley of Desolation's columns as the showpiece

questions.question: The kimberlite pipes at Cullinan and Venetia are economically vital because they:
options: Hoisted DIAMONDS up from mantle depths and are mined for them today

questions.question: The deadliest volcanic hazard, which destroyed St Pierre on Martinique in 1902 within minutes, is the:
options: PYROCLASTIC FLOW — an avalanche of incandescent gas, ash and rock faster than any vehicle

questions.question: A lahar, like the one that buried Armero in Colombia in 1985, is:
options: A volcanic mudflow of ash mixed with rain or meltwater, pouring down valleys far from the summit
A crack in the crater wall

questions.question: People farm volcanic slopes near Naples and across Java mainly because:
options: Land there is free of any risk
Eruptions are impossible twice in one place
Weathered ash and lava give exceptionally fertile soils rich in potassium, phosphorus and magnesium

questions.question: Mount Pinatubo in 1991 proves the value of volcano management because:
options: The eruption was smaller than predicted
Monitoring read the warnings — quake swarms, swelling ground, rising gas — and tens of thousands were evacuated before one of the century's largest eruptions

questions.question: In the two-pot picture, the thin soup and the stiff pap stand for:
options: Runny low-silica magma that lets gas escape gently, and thick high-silica magma that traps gas until it bursts free

questions.question: A volcano fed by thick magma 'does not leak; it detonates' because the stiff melt:
options: Cools the gas until it disappears
Plugs the pipe like a cork while gas pressure stacks up for years

questions.question: 'The geography chooses the pot' means that:
options: Plates pulling apart deliver runny low-silica basalt, while plates diving under each other brew thick high-silica magma
Silica has no effect on eruptions

subtopics.title: Syrup, Lasagne and the Sand Heap

questions.question: Syrup spreading on a cold plate models the:
options: SHIELD volcano — runny lava travelling far, building a wide cone with barely noticeable slopes

questions.question: In the lasagne model of a composite volcano, the mince and the pasta sheets are:
options: Loose ash scattered by explosions, and the lava flows that set hard over each ash layer, locking it down

questions.question: Parícutin, which grew out of a flat Mexican field within one lifetime, is a:
options: CINDER CONE — a small, steep heap of fragments with an oversized crater

questions.question: All volcano types share the same plumbing, namely:
options: A caldera, a sill and a dyke
A crater at the bottom and a chamber at the top
The magma chamber as tank, the vent as pipe, the crater as funnel mouth — with occasional side pipes making parasitic cones

questions.question: The Drakensberg skyline runs in level ramparts and giant stairs because:
options: It is the stacked edge of basalt sheets that flooded from fissures as Gondwana tore apart
It is a row of collapsed calderas

questions.question: The Valley of Desolation outside Graaff-Reinet displays:
options: Colossal columns of dolerite — magma that cooled underground and was exposed by erosion
A field of young cinder cones

questions.question: On the ledger of debits and credits, which pair is CORRECTLY matched?
options: Debit: fertile soils; credit: pyroclastic flows
Debit: the pyroclastic flow, a glowing hurricane no vehicle outruns; credit: ash-fed soils among the richest on earth
